ImageDescription.value: Photo portrait of American jazz guitarist, posed with a Gibson L-5, from a 1967 print advertisement for Gibson guitars.

DateTimeOriginal.value: Published 1967 but was likely taken earlier; the ad indicates Montgomery was pictured in a recording session for Verve, a label he had been signed to from around 1964–1966.

Credit.value: Composite retouch based on scans via Vintage Guitar & Bass (showing the full original ad), Indianapolis Star, and NPR.org.

Artist.value: Photo first published by Gibson. According to NPR, the photo was taken by Chuck Stewart.
